title: RAID BACKPACK GRID FILLS THE CARD
why: The critic held the raid backpack at 2 of 5 (target 4): a small under-filled box with a tiny 3-item grid and two name sizes. Tiles are now the guide 88 px, at least two rows of empty cells are drawn so the grid fills the card, and the selected item name is the one hero at title size. Rendering only; nothing carried changes.
now: The raid backpack shows a full grid of larger tiles and a bigger selected item name.
